description: Avoid single-character variable names — they hurt readability
Cache repeated database lookups inside the request loop
Never interpolate raw user input directly into SQL queries
Validate and sanitize user-controlled file paths
Avoid nested loops when a set or dictionary lookup is sufficient
Keep database access behind a service or repository boundary
Use small focused functions instead of large multi-purpose functions
Avoid mutable default arguments in Python functions
Avoid loose equality when strict equality is available
Use parameterized queries and avoid string concatenation for SQL
